title: Day 87: U.S. AFRICOM Warns Congress — CJNG Establishing Meth Labs in Africa; El Sapo Hunt Day 87; Plan Kukulkan 22 Days
detail: Day 87 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CJNG AFRICA LABS — U.S. AFRICOM WARNING TO CONGRESS (May 20, 2026): A U.S. Africa Command (AFRICOM) general warned the U.S. Senate that CJNG and the Sinaloa Cartel have established clandestine methamphetamine production laboratories in Africa — primarily in South Africa — to exploit permissive regulatory environments, distribute to European and Middle Eastern markets, and route product back globally. The largest lab identified, near Swarttruggens (~170km northwest of Johannesburg, South Africa), had four Mexican nationals detained at the site. Of 12 identified clandestine cartel labs across the African continent, 11 were intercepted. The testimony confirms CJNG's transnational manufacturing strategy extends well beyond the Chile-to-Australia model documented May 17 (where Chilean prosecutors sought 35-year sentences for two CJNG nationals who produced 844kg of meth for Australian distribution). Multiple Mexican outlets — El Financiero, Infobae, La Silla Rota, Diario de Yucatán, and Latinus — published the AFRICOM testimony on May 20. TRANSNATIONAL RESILIENCE CONTEXT: Together with the Chile meth hub (May 17) and CJNG's established fentanyl precursor pipeline through Manzanillo, the Africa labs testimony demonstrates that CJNG's manufacturing and distribution architecture has been pre-positioned across multiple continents — resilient to the post-Mencho leadership disruption. El Sapo (military wing) and El 03 (financial/logistics wing) continue managing an organization with genuine global reach. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 87 (NO CAPTURE): Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target. No confirmed operation, arrest, or elimination reported on Day 87. PLAN KUKULKAN — 22 DAYS: Twenty-two days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City). Guadalajara's Akron Stadium hosts four group-stage matches in CJNG's historic operational heartland. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 11: Eleven days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9) — no successor plaza boss named. Port operating under enhanced Navy-SEMAR surveillance. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 87: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14; Lagos de Moreno crematory linked), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. 47+ confirmed CJNG HVTs neutralized. SUCCESSION BINARY — DAY 87: El 03 (confirmed CJNG leader, financial wing) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION — DAY 87: Ongoing with no charges announced.

media.caption: U.S. AFRICOM warns Congress: CJNG and Sinaloa Cartel have established meth production labs in Africa — largest site near Swarttruggens, South Africa, with 4 Mexican nationals detained
Infobae: Largest clandestine drug lab in South Africa linked to Mexican cartels including CJNG — U.S. intelligence testimony to Senate confirms transnational cartel meth manufacturing expansion
